title: Bunty Babli Cleaning Service Website (Marketing + Contact)

requirements.text: Create a responsive marketing website for “Bunty Babli Cleaning Service” with core sections: Hero (headline + short value proposition), Services, Pricing (or “Get a Quote” if pricing is not fixed), About, Service Area/Locations (generic text, no maps), Testimonials, FAQ, and Contact.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders all specified sections and is usable on mobile and desktop.
Navigation allows jumping to each section (e.g., top nav anchors) and highlights/works correctly.
All user-facing text is in English and consistently uses the brand name “Bunty Babli Cleaning Service”.

requirements.text: Add a contact/inquiry form that collects: full name, phone number, email (optional), service type (select), preferred date (optional), address/area (text), and message; validate required fields client-side and show success/error states.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: Form prevents submission when required fields are missing and displays clear inline validation messages.
On successful submission, the form resets and a confirmation message is shown.
On failure, an error message is shown and the user can retry without losing entered data (except fields already validated).

requirements.text: Implement backend storage for contact/inquiry submissions in the single Motoko actor, including APIs to create an inquiry and list inquiries for basic review.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a method to create/store an inquiry with timestamp.
Backend exposes a method to list stored inquiries (most recent first).
Data persists across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns appropriate for Motoko.

requirements.text: Wire the frontend contact form to the backend inquiry API using React Query for mutation state and error handling.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form calls the backend method and displays loading state while pending.
React Query mutation handles and displays backend errors.
No direct backend calls from components without the established actor hook pattern; use existing actor access approach (without modifying immutable hook files).

requirements.text: Create a coherent, distinctive visual theme for the site (colors, typography, spacing, component style) suitable for a local cleaning service brand, and apply it consistently across all sections. Avoid a blue/purple primary palette.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across headings, buttons, cards, and section backgrounds.
Primary palette is not blue/purple; the site looks cohesive and intentional.
Components follow accessible contrast and readable typography on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Add basic SEO and metadata: page title, meta description, and Open Graph tags for the Bunty Babli Cleaning Service homepage.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab title reflects the business name.
Meta description is present and relevant.
Open Graph title/description are set for link previews.

requirements.text: Generate and include required static images as frontend assets and use them in the UI (do not serve images through the backend). Place generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them from the homepage.

quotes: Bunty babli cleaning service wab site

acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Homepage uses the logo and hero image in the layout without broken links.
Service icons are used in the Services section (or feature cards) and render sharply on common screen densities.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo when present).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them only).
Do not modify immutable frontend hook entrypoints listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; integrate by adding new hooks/components instead.
nonGoals: Real-time chat, SMS, push notifications, or email sending integrations.
Third-party auth providers (only Internet Identity is supported, but not required for this marketing site).
Maps, geolocation, or embedded location services.

required: Wordmark-style logo on transparent background, clean and friendly, with broom/sparkle motif (bunty-babli-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Wide hero banner illustration/photo-style graphic featuring a tidy home/office and cleaning tools, warm and welcoming (cleaning-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
Set of 4 simple line/flat icons: broom, spray bottle, mop, bucket (cleaning-icons-set.dim_512x512.png)
